# espllm -- llama2.c inference on the ESP32-S3, plus an OpenAI-compatible API.
#
# espllm_engine.c is generated by tools/port_llama2.py from
# third_party/llama2.c/run.c and stays free of ESP-IDF includes; the rest of
# the component is what adapts it to flash partitions, FreeRTOS and httpd.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "espllm.c"
        "espllm_model.c"
        "espllm_engine.c"
        "espllm_http.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "include"
    PRIV_REQUIRES
        esp_http_server
        esp_https_server   # GET /talk 的 TLS 监听口（浏览器只在安全上下文里给麦克风）
        esp_partition
        esp_timer
        heap
)
